{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Verify the number of sites
print("Number of unique sites:", len(df['site'].unique()))
print("Sites:", df['site'].unique())

# Calculate response rate per site
response_rate_by_site = df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean() * 100
print("Response rates by site:")
print(response_rate_by_site)

# Find the site with the highest response rate
best_site = response_rate_by_site.idxmax()
best_rate = response_rate_by_site.max()

print(f"Site with highest response rate: {best_site} with {best_rate:.2f}%")"}
